statement: (x y z : NNReal) : x + y + z - 3 * (x * y * z)^(1 / 3) ≥ 0
closed: ∀ (x y z : NNReal), x + y + z - 3 * (x * y * z)^(1 / 3) ≥ 0
informal:
[Proof] 
Let $A:=x^{1/3}, B:=y^{1/3}, C:=z^{1/3}$ . 
We first observe that 
 $A^3+B^3+C^3-3ABC= rac{1}{2}(A+B+C)((A-B)^2+(B-C)^2+(C-A)^2)$ As $A, B, C$ are nonnegative, the right side of the above equality is nonnegative. 
So $A^3+B^3+C^3-3ABC \ge 0$ 
 $	herefore x+y+z-3\sqrt[3]{xyz} \ge 0$ 
 $Q. E. D.$
